reason: Free is nice and I like that I don't have to connect Instagram, but I've never heard of Mitra and I already ignore most collab DMs because they look fake. I'm not handing my deal screenshots and number to another new app until someone I know says it actually got them paid.
objection: Who is behind this? An app that reads my DMs and deals could be the scam itself, and I don't want one more app on my phone when everything already happens in WhatsApp.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I follow in Bengaluru showing a real café or gym deal they got through it, with the fee, and me being able to just forward a DM on WhatsApp without installing anything.
